key_idea: The grid is at most 50x50, so just try every cell as the restaurant and sum weighted Manhattan distances.
sketch: Brute force over all n*m candidate cells, computing sum g[i][j]*(|i-a|+|j-b|) for each: O((nm)^2) = 6.25M operations. A faster alternative is independent weighted medians of row and column sums, but it is unnecessary. Answer fits easily in 64-bit (max about 50*2500*100). Note the sample has n=1 despite the stated n>1, so do not assume n,m>=2.
